title: Lab - View certificate details
description: Audit the cluster certificates and fix a broken one.
scenario: Audit the cluster certificates and fix a broken one. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Find
tasks.instructions: Which file holds the API server certificate, and what is its CN and expiry?

tasks.title: Task 2 - SANs
tasks.instructions: List the alternative names on the API server certificate.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Repair
tasks.instructions: The API server cannot reach etcd after a certificate was swapped. Find the wrong path in the manifest and fix it.
tasks.solution:
crictl ps -a | grep apiserver; crictl logs <id>
# fix --etcd-cafile path in kube-apiserver.yaml
